sources: Twilio SendGrid, Tracking and link branding: click links are rewritten onto sendgrid.net unless the sender brands them (reviewed 2026-10-01). https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/ui/account-and-settings/tracking
Postmark, Link tracking: unbranded clicks use click.pstmrk.it. https://postmarkapp.com/blog/feature-announcement-link-tracking
Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill), Activity and reports: default click URLs use mandrillapp.com. https://mailchimp.com/developer/transactional/docs/activity-reports/

Iterable Support, Email link shortening and click tracking: the default host is links.iterable.com. https://support.iterable.com/hc/en-us/articles/37964014151188-Email-Link-Shortening-and-Click-Tracking
Klaviyo Help Center, dedicated click tracking: shared click hosts are used until a branded domain is turned on (reviewed 2026-10-01). https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001550572
EasyList easyprivacy_general_emailtrackers.txt and the Rspamd redirectors map, reviewed 2026-10-01, for the remaining provider hosts named below.
